blocks.text: This is a spreadsheet. Open the .xlsx file; this page describes it.

items: Enter the school, educators, learners and rate type.
Standard monthly = the larger of the minimum and the built-up price.
Community rate applies the community factor.
Annual prepay applies the prepay discount to twelve months.
VAT is added at the rate in the Rates block.

blocks.text: The rates are the company’s proposed pricing, provisional until decision D-1 is final. Change a rate once, in the Rates block, and every result follows.
